environment_notes: This repo does not use pytest. Every test_*.py is a standalone script using a local check(label, ok)/FAILED-list convention, invoked as `python3 <file>` (see .cline/test.sh, the repo's real CI gate). For PRs adding a brand-new test file, the merge-commit's test file was copied into the base worktree (unmodified) so it imports the base's real pre-fix source — correct base reproduction, SWE-bench style. For PR32 the base worktree's OWN pre-fix evals/recap data files were used since those files are themselves the fix. Ollama was live on localhost:11434 during mining, which activates a conditional real-model e2e test in PR28's file — handled by isolating to the two specific test functions. All worktrees created under scratchpad with --detach and removed after; no checkout/reset/stash touched the repo's working tree.
